scope: Production exploration scene. Explicit scenario-start teleports are fixtures, not a continuous route. Source facade/ground anchors, real camera ray/projection, viewport bounds, hidden states and physical E taps are checked. Native GPU geometry checks read actual uploaded MultiMesh transforms; headless dummy checks only CPU submissions and defers native readback. Synthetic occluder is a line-of-sight fault fixture. Headless output has no GPU capture or human-input acceptance; native captures use force_draw. No surveyed entrance, entire 126-building visit, performance, packaging or cross-Mac claim.
